subject: Discovery recap — pick a 30-minute walkthrough and tech attendee
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Reynolds <kate@aureliahealth.com>, Tom Lee <tom@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Discovery recap — pick a 30-minute walkthrough and tech attendee

Hi Kate & Tom,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciated the candid overview of your data flow and latency constraints. Quick recap from my side and a proposal for next steps to keep momentum: 

What we heard (high level):
- Primary need: consistent sub-200ms tail latency for user-facing autocomplete across 2M daily queries.
- Success metrics: 95th token latency <200ms, cost target ~ $0.0008 per 1k tokens, and clear data residency controls for PHI.
- Constraints: Tom mentioned a background batch pipeline and a gated procurement window at the end of Q2.

Suggested next step: 30-minute product walkthrough focused on infra + latency profile (we'll bring an engineer to discuss batching, quantization options and routing policies). Could you confirm who from your side should join as the technical owner — Tom or someone from infra?

Two proposed windows (all times ET):
- Wed, May 12 — 11:00–11:30am ET
- Fri, May 14 — 10:00–10:30am ET
- If neither works, propose two alternatives and we’ll accommodate. We can also offer a CEST option if that’s easier for EU stakeholders.

Attached: redwood-one-pager.pdf (high-level), performance-matrix.xlsx (profiling examples).

Next items from us if you lock a slot: a short pre-demo checklist and a Google Meet link.

Thanks — looking forward to lining up the tech folks.

Best,
David Kim
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- redwood-one-pager.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
- performance-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 1 sheet)

From: Kate Reynolds <kate@aureliahealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Discovery recap — pick a 30-minute walkthrough and tech attendee

Thanks, David — great summary. Quick notes:
- Appreciate the concise success criteria.
- Tom will be out Wednesday afternoon; Friday is preferable for our infra lead.
- Our procurement window is indeed the last week of the month; we’d like a short demo + some perf numbers to feed into the MA.

Friday, May 14 10:00–10:30am ET works for me. Can you confirm the engineer who will join from your side? Also, please include a quick list of any logs/metrics we should have available for the session (sampling, recent latency histograms).

We’ll put a 30-minute slot on the calendar for Fri, May 14, 10:00–10:30am ET and send a Google Meet link. David (meets latency/infra) will be joined by our infra engineer, Neha Kapoor, who will cover batching/quantization tradeoffs.

- If you can share one representative latency histogram (95/99) and QPS baseline that would help us tailor the demo.

Calendar: "30m — Redwood product walkthrough (Aurelia Health)" — invite sent (Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/rdw-demo-7421).
